description:
LEVER (d), s500p perf round 37 (RUNTIME-ONLY).  The operators' SLOW paths on a still-BOXED plain number.

PROFILE LINES (s500p Step 0, main 209e7533): 0553-Fusc-sequence (1.26 s vs perl 0.74 s): box-set 12.5 %, p->> 17.3 % total, %p-true-p-slow 9.6 %, %p-binary-bit-op 18.8 %, %p-bitwise-operand-kind 4.9 %, to-number 5.2 %.  0041-Air-mass: %p-*-slow 5.7 %, %p->-slow 3.6 %, %p-<-slow 3.2 %, to-number 4.2 %.  1385-Sub-unit-squares: %p->-slow 9.6 %.  1508-Vampire-number: %p-%-slow 7.0 %.
WHY THE SLOW PATH: a scalar the raw-numeric verdict declined stays a p-box (a list declaration `my ($p,$q,$i) = (0,1,shift)` -- #2114's family; every lexical of a signature sub -- #2514), and the inline fast arms test (numberp a).  The slow paths then paid the overload test, TWO nomethod lookups in every comparison (%p-nomethod-binary ran even when no overload was possible), the bitwise operand classification, and generic to-number calls -- all of them identities for a box holding a plain number.

FIX: %p-plain-num -- the number a raw operand is, or a box whose PAYLOAD is a number holds (the NV cache when valid, as box-nv answers; a numeric payload makes overload impossible and excludes tie proxies and magic cells) -- and a first arm on it in: %def-overloaded-arith's slow fn (+ *), %p---slow, %p-/-slow, %p-%-slow (fixnums, p-%'s own arm), %def-overloaded-cmp's slow fn (== != < > <= >=, NaN rule kept), p-<< / p->> (fixnums, same clamp), p-bit-and / p-bit-or / p-bit-xor (non-negative fixnums, via %plain-ubyte-bit-arm), and %p-true-p-slow (a box whose payload is a number or a string).
PROBES: scratch/s500p/dprobe.pl in the s500p worktree -- 12x12 operand classes (int, double, "12", "3.5abc", 0, -0.0, Inf, NaN, 1e308, negative) x every operator + `use overload` handlers on every key + `nomethod` + dualvar + a tied scalar (FETCH count) + undef + 1e308*10 + fixnum overflow + string bit-ops: perl == base == tree, 152 lines byte-identical.


=== DONE (s500p) ===
Shipped: %p-plain-num first arms in the + * (macro) - / % slow paths, the six comparisons, & | ^ (non-negative fixnums), << >> (fixnums), %p-true-p-slow (number/string payload).  Every arm falls through to the OLD general path for anything it does not recognise (NIL from %p-plain-num) -- no default value.  Commit f99c0891.  SIZED (lever alone, load 4-10): Fusc -63 %, Air-mass -10 %, m-box -49 %.  WHOLE TREE (s501, K=5, load 1.6-3.9): Fusc 1.611 -> 0.794 (-50.7 %; perl 0.738 -- now near perl), Air-mass 1.591 -> 1.494 (-6.1 %; the rest is #2514's boxes).  bench boxarith (new row) 0.2925 -> 0.1481 s (-49.4 %).  Review found a PRE-EXISTING shift divergence the arm faithfully keeps: filed #2516.
